Hi all,

I pulled together the minimal bundle and notes below. Attaching the formal hosting statement and a network diagram. Also attaching the exported SIG/CAIQ answers that reference regional controls.

Summary (short):
- Data residency: For "EU" region deployments we persist customer data (application data, snapshots/backups, and operational logs) only in EU-hosted clusters. Cross-region replication is opt-in and requires explicit configuration; default provisioning does not replicate outside region.
- Backups & retention: Backups for EU deployments are stored in-region by default. Retention settings are customer-configurable; we can provide retention export screenshots or formal retention SLA language.
- Private deployment / VPC model:
  - Option A (Private VPC peering): Customer creates VPC in their cloud account; we peer and route to dedicated Redwood nodes in the EU region. Customer controls subnets and routing.
  - Option B (Redwood-managed VPC with tenant isolation): For customers who prefer Redwood manage networking, we support isolated subnets per-customer in EU regions with strict tenancy and encryption-at-rest.
- KMS & keys:
  - Customer-managed KMS: We support bring-your-own-key (BYOK) in EU regions via standard KMS integrations (Azure Key Vault / AWS KMS / GCP Cloud KMS) for encryption of persisted model caches and sensitive artifacts.
  - Redwood-managed keys: available for customers who do not want BYOK.
- Audit & logs: Audit logs for private deployments are delivered to customer endpoints (syslog/S3/GCS) and retained per contract. Our platform also keeps internal audit trails for administrative actions; those are covered by SOC 2 Type II.
- SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ: The attached SIG export highlights regional and network controls; our SOC 2 Type II report covers configuration controls and encryption; CAIQ responses point to our deployment-specific artifacts.

Attachments included: redwood_eu_region_hosting_statement.pdf, network_arch_diagram_vpc_peering.png, sig_ca_downloadable_answers_202605.pdf

Notes / action items (internal):
- Maya: please confirm whether the default backup bucket encryption metadata is included in the hosting statement or if we should add a short note.
- Vanessa: I left a short paragraph in the hosting statement describing cross-region replication being opt-in.

Happy to jump on a call with Acme security to walk through the sections.

-Karthik
